title: Farming Simulator 22
description: Farming Simulator 22's dedicated server comes with the game - there is no free server download - and hosting counts as playing it, so to play on your own server you need a second licence / Steam account. Steam version: press Install with Steam on its card - your Steam client downloads the game (it has to be on the account signed in on this PC), ServerDeck shows the progress, then runs dedicatedServer.exe on your desktop next to Steam (Windows logged on; Steam is started if it isn't running). Giants version (the one Giants recommends for servers): install it yourself and set the folder below. dedicatedServer.exe is the web page you run the farm from (http://127.0.0.1:<web port>): start the farm there and turn on its autostart. On the first start ServerDeck sets the page's admin login in dedicatedServer.xml; it opens the web and game ports and backs up the savegames (Documents\My Games\FarmingSimulator2022). Updates come from Steam / Giants. About 4-8 GB of RAM.
